name: MaCCI Annual Conference 2027
organizer: Mannheim Centre for Competition and Innovation (MaCCI): ZEW Mannheim and University of Mannheim
venue: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research, L 7, 1, 68161 Mannheim
submission_requirements: PDF in English to MacciAnnual2027@zew.de; individual submissions need an abstract (max. 200 words), author name, affiliation and contact details; only full papers, but incomplete drafts welcome; full-session proposals (usually 3 papers, with session abstract) encouraged; presenters are expected to discuss another paper. Competition economics and competition law (legal scholars encouraged); special sessions by Bundeskartellamt, European Commission, Studienvereinigung Kartellrecht and ASCOLA Germany
registration_fee: EUR 150 academia and public sector / EUR 300 private sector (non-refundable)
membership_required: No membership requirement stated in the last call
